review.posthog_relevance: Adds photo attachment and metadata support to the Desktop mobilehog transcript UI, including shared URI handling, presigned URL retrieval, and regression tests for HEIC and prompt content.
review.reason: The change introduces a cohesive set of modifications across the Desktop mobilehog application. P1.F1 and P1.F2 establish the UI and shared state for photo attachments, while P1.F8 and P1.F9 add typed support and tests. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
